title: Allow {{client}} to use Attraccess?
intro: This app asks to act on your behalf through the Attraccess MCP interface. It can only do what is listed below, and only what you are allowed to do yourself.

loopback.title: App on this device
loopback.message: The app returns to {{host}}, which is this device. Only continue if you started it yourself.

external.title: Check the address
external.message: The app returns to {{host}}. Only continue if you recognize and trust it.

selfRegistered: The app registered itself, so Attraccess cannot confirm its name.

permissions.title: Permissions to allow
permissions.hint: Choose what the app may do. You can allow more or less than it asked for, but never more than you are allowed to do yourself.
permissions.all: The app did not name specific permissions, so it asks for everything you can do today ({{count}} permissions).
permissions.none: You currently hold no permissions that the app could use.
permissions.label: Permissions

picker.title: Choose what the app may do
picker.description: Select the minimum access the app needs. It can use only permissions you currently hold.

unavailable.title: Not allowed for your account
unavailable.message: The app asks for permissions you do not have: {{permissions}}. Allowing it sends an error back to the app.

returningApproved: Access allowed. Returning to the app… If nothing happens, you can close this tab.
returningDenied: Access denied. Returning to the app… If nothing happens, you can close this tab.
notice: Access lasts up to 7 days. Denying has no effect on your account. If a permission is taken from you in Attraccess, the app loses it too.

error.title: This request cannot be answered
error.expired: The authorization request has expired or was already answered. Start the connection again from your app.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Start the connection again from your app.
error.missing: The link is incomplete. Start the connection again from your app.
error.disabled: MCP sign-in is not available on this server. Use an API token instead.
error.framed: For your safety, this page cannot be shown inside another page. Open the link in its own browser tab.

authorizeError.title: The app cannot connect
authorizeError.invalid_client: This app is not registered with Attraccess. Start the connection again from your app.
authorizeError.invalid_redirect_uri: The app asked to return to an address it did not register. Start the connection again from your app.
authorizeError.request: The app sent an invalid sign-in request ({{code}}). Start the connection again from your app or contact its developer.

tools.title: {{count}} tools enabled
tools.description: The app can use these tools with the permissions you selected. Each call is still checked against your permissions.
tools.none: No tools are enabled by this selection.

selectionError: This selection could not be allowed. Check it and try again, or start the connection again from your app.
